Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.   KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 1.	Participate in company training on relevant software technologies, development tools, and processes. Provide regular work reports and updates. 2.	Software Development Projects: Contribute to the rapid prototype development and testing of semiconductor equipment software for inspection, metrology and data analysis systems. Existing code analysis, refactoring and performance optimization. 3.	Test Automation Projects: Participate in developing tools for automated testing, deployment, and operations based on CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery) processes. 4.	Work at least 3 full days per week, following standard company working hours. 5.	Outstanding performance during the internship may lead to a full-time offer through campus recruitment. Solid knowledge of CS and SW engineering: DSA, multithreading, OOP, design patterns, etc. 4.	Experience with projects related to AI / LLM / AI Agents is preferred. 5.	Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. 6.	Fluent in English, with good communication skills, teamwork spirit, and a proactive, self-driven attitude. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
